bullets.text: Windows 11 Insider Preview Updates — New features like seamless app resumption from Android phones are rolling out to Insiders.
Windows 11 Beta Channel Enhancements — Similar features for app resumption from Android are now available for Beta Channel Insiders.
My Apps Feature for Xbox Insiders — A new feature allows quick access to games and third-party apps on Windows 11.
Microsoft's Open Source Leadership — The company has evolved into a leading contributor to open source, enhancing AI capabilities.
Gartner Magic Quadrant Recognition — Microsoft is named a Leader in Cloud-Native Application Platforms for the second consecutive year.
ClickFix Social Engineering Threat — New social engineering tactics are targeting users, emphasizing the need for security awareness.
Designing Multi-Agent Intelligence — The shift towards multi-agent systems is crucial for modern enterprise AI applications.
Windows Copilot Enhancements — New semantic search capabilities are being introduced to improve file retrieval on Windows.
Quantum-Safe Security Initiatives — Microsoft is preparing for quantum computing risks by developing post-quantum cryptography standards.
Building the Frontier Firm — Organizations are leveraging Azure for cloud and AI modernization to gain competitive advantages.
